en.title: Its Tentacles Reach 30 Meters! Can You Name It?
en.description: The lion's mane jellyfish has tentacles up to 30 m long, a bell that can exceed 2 m and about 1,200 oral arms. Its detached tentacles can keep stinging for up to 25 days.
